description: This file contains implementation of engine control logic, including trigger initialization, sensor updates, engine state management, and shutdown procedures for an engine control system.

classes.name: FsioState
classes.description: Represents the state of the filesystem I/O subsystem, with flags for engine warnings and critical conditions.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Main class managing engine control, including trigger handling, sensor updates, engine state, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: initializeTriggerShape
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape and synchronizes trigger events.

methods.name: periodicSlowCallback
methods.description: Performs periodic slow engine tasks such as watchdog, sensor updates, and shutdown checks.

methods.name: updateSlowSensors
methods.description: Updates slow-changing sensor data like RPM, fuel level, and battery voltage.

methods.name: onTriggerSignalEvent
methods.description: Handles trigger signal events, marking the engine as spinning and recording event time.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets engine state variables to initial conditions.

methods.name: preCalculate
methods.description: Prepares helper structures after configuration changes, such as spark tables and MAF lookup.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets engine configuration and initializes related parameters.

methods.name: knockLogic
methods.description: Processes knock voltage signals to determine knock events and adjust ignition timing.

methods.name: watchdog
methods.description: Monitors engine activity and stops engine if no trigger events are detected within a threshold.

methods.name: checkShutdown
methods.description: Checks conditions to initiate engine shutdown, such as low battery voltage.

methods.name: isInShutdownMode
methods.description: Returns whether the engine is currently in shutdown mode.

methods.name: getCurrentInjectionMode
methods.description: Returns the current injection mode based on engine state.

methods.name: periodicFastCallback
methods.description: Performs fast periodic engine tasks like updating injection duration and fuel calculations.
